title: HAPACT: A Benchmark For Human-Centric Physical Impact Localization in Movies
abstract: arXiv:2610.22895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical reasoning about humans in videos has largely focused on everyday interactions, where contact, pressure, pose, and motion support embodied perception and contact-aware applications. Still, short and forceful properties like impact events remain relatively underexplored, despite their relevance to broader understanding of how abrupt physical events affect the human body. To fill this gap, we introduce human-centric impact localization, a new task that localizes target physical impacts temporally within a video and spatially on the human body. We further present HAPACT, a HumAn-centric imPACT dataset and benchmark built from movie clips, containing over 2.8K video-query pairs with more than 20K fine-grained human-annotated frames. We built HAPACT around viewer-grounded annotation, text-conditioned localization, and supervision at frame-level temporal and SMPL-X-based spatial granularity. translated_title: HAPACT：一个面向电影中以人为中心的物理冲击定位的基准数据集
translated_abstract: 视频中关于人类的物理推理研究主要集中于日常交互场景，其中接触、压力、姿态和运动支撑着具身感知和接触感知应用。然而，像冲击事件这类短暂而强烈的现象仍然相对缺乏探索，尽管它们对于更广泛地理解突发物理事件如何影响人体具有重要意义。为填补这一空白，我们提出了以人为中心的冲击定位这一新任务，即在视频中从时间维度定位目标物理冲击，并在人体上进行空间定位。我们进一步提出了HAPACT——一个基于电影片段构建的以人为中心的冲击数据集与基准，包含超过2800个视频-查询对以及超过20000个细粒度的人工标注帧。我们围绕基于观众视角的标注、文本条件下的定位，以及帧级时间粒度和基于SMPL-X的空间粒度的监督来构建HAPACT。为了验证我们基准的有效性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了“以人为中心的冲击定位”这一新任务，并构建了基于电影片段的HAPACT数据集与基准，通过帧级时间标注和基于SMPL-X的空间标注，实现对视频中人体物理冲击的时间与空间双重定位。
